title: Lab - Configure SSH servers and clients
description: Move to key-based SSH and close the password door.
scenario: Move to key-based SSH and close the password door. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own VM and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# Any Linux VM with sudo will do - Ubuntu 22.04 or Rocky 9, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM.
# Snapshot it before you start so a broken task is a revert away.
sudo -i
hostnamectl
cleanup: # Revert the VM snapshot, or undo the changes you made by hand.

tasks.title: Task 1 - Keys
tasks.instructions: Generate an ed25519 key pair and install it for user ana on the server.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Harden
tasks.instructions: Disable password authentication and root login in sshd_config and reload.
tasks.solution:
# PasswordAuthentication no ; PermitRootLogin no
sshd -t && systemctl reload sshd

tasks.title: Task 3 - Client config
tasks.instructions: Add a Host entry so that `ssh lab` reaches ana@server on port 2222.
tasks.solution: # ~/.ssh/config: Host lab / HostName server / User ana / Port 2222
